data.summary: The redirect directory is a single-file static web root that replaced the retired per-sandbox workbench SPA (unified Phase 6, D1). Its only file, index.html, is served at "/" and either bounces the browser to the Sandbox manager (mgr-web) or explains where the old UI went, while leaving all /api/* backend routes untouched. It is a thin presentation-layer shim with no business logic, APIs, or data access of its own.

file_insights.name: index.html
file_insights.summary: Static HTML landing/redirect page served at the web root after the per-sandbox workbench SPA was retired; it redirects users to the Sandbox manager or explains the migration, and does not touch any /api/* endpoints.
file_insights.source_summary: A minimal HTML5 document (lang="zh-CN") with charset and viewport meta tags and a title, followed by a comment block documenting that app/redirect is the static root served since web/ retired. The body (truncated in the provided excerpt) hosts the redirect/explanation content; there is no JavaScript framework, build step, or data fetching beyond browser-level navigation/redirect.
file_insights.detailed_description: This file is the static tree served at "/" since the web/ frontend was retired in unified Phase 6 (D1). It contains no application logic: it exists purely to route or inform visitors arriving at the old root URL, pointing them at the Sandbox manager (mgr-web), which reaches backend APIs through the mgr proxy at /api/sbx/:name/* (契约 10). Because all app APIs remain untouched, this page is a compatibility/UX shim rather than a functional component of the system.
responsibilities: Serve as the static root document for "/" after the web/ SPA retirement
Redirect or guide the browser toward the Sandbox manager (mgr-web) UI
Explain to users where the previous per-sandbox workbench UI went
Remain decoupled from all /api/* endpoints, which are served unchanged
